text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Wednesday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The port of Ventspils will mark its 100th anniversary on May 20-25.
- An alleged Latvian gangster, Viktors Balulis, was shot dead Monday afternoon in Amsterdam.
- The chairman of the LNNK, Juris Dobelis, was expelled from his parliamentary group.
- Italian president Oscar Luiggi Scalfaro arrives today on his first official visit to Latvia.

- Latvian ports are beating cargo turnover records. Compared to first the four months of the previous year, the total bulk of cargoes handled in Latvia increased by more than 2.5 million tonnes to 16.1 million tonnes. The port of Ventspils share amounted to 12.86 million tonnes.
The trade union of teachers decided to organise an action of protest. The teachers are demanding a minimum monthly salary of 60 lats to be raised with the inflation rate.

- EU experts have completed studies of the tourist industry in Latvia and worked out a development plan to the year 2000. According to the study, tourism accounted for 2.9 percent of Latvia's GDP in 1996.
